entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied accepted Hangeul Valley farmer reference into a new vocabulary icon for Korean “달리다”. Input image is the shared STYLE and character parent, not a subject to copy unchanged. The same farmer RUNNING in a clear side profile to the right, long airborne stride with both feet off the ground, knees high, arms bent and pumping, hat secure. No bag, no shoe alone. Use two short motion ticks behind the body. The full body and BOTH complete legs and boots must be intact.
Style: authentic SNES / Stardew 16-bit pixel art, designed on a strict 48 by 48 logical pixel grid, enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels. Chunky 1-2 logical pixel deep-brown outline, warm oak, cream, muted sage, denim blue and amber palette, simple flat clusters, at most 20 colors. Keep large readable silhouettes and complete solid shapes when reduced to 48px tall. Front-facing orthographic 2D except the explicitly requested side/top pose. Exactly one isolated semantic vignette, centered with a small transparent margin. TRUE TRANSPARENT background; no magenta, white backing, floor, ground, text, letters, frame, gradient, glow, blur, anti-aliasing, dithering or tiny noisy details. Preserve the family warmth and farmer identity where a person is requested; make the requested subject unmistakable.
entries.backgroundEditPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit ONLY the backdrop of the supplied finished pixel-art vocabulary icon.
